caption: A complete k-ary tree is always a tree ($n - 1$ edges, connected)
The root of a 3-level ternary tree has 3 children
A 4-level binary tree has 1+2+4+8 = 15 vertices, same as CompleteKaryTree(4, 2)
The heap layout -- vertex $i$'s children are $2i, 2i+1$
Default is binary: 5 levels hold 31 vertices
Three levels with branching 3 give 13 vertices
Two levels of ternary branching: a root with 3 leaves
Eccentricity grows from the root's 2 to 4 at the leaves
No vertex is joined to itself
